IHG Hotels & Resorts FAQs

IHG Hotels & Resorts is one of the world's leading hospitality companies, offering a diverse portfolio of brands and collections designed to fit every travel style, occasion and budget from luxury and lifestyle experiences like Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Kimpton, Hotel Indigo and Vignette Collection; to premium stays such as Crowne Plaza, EVEN Hotels, Ruby Hotels, voco and HUALUXE; to trusted essentials including Holiday Inn, Holiday Inn Express, Holiday Inn Resort, Holiday Inn Club Vacations, Holiday Inn – the niu, avid hotels and Garner; plus all-suite options like Staybridge Suites, Candlewood Suites and Atwell Suites, as well as speciality offerings including Iberostar Beachfront Resorts ensuring the right stay for business, leisure, extended trips and everything in between.

When you book directly with IHG through our website or mobile app, you get benefits that third-party travel sites simply can't offer. IHG One Rewards members unlock exclusive Member rates with savings up to 10% or more, earn valuable points to redeem for reward nights, get early access to special promotions and flash sales, and enjoy member-only perks like free Wi-Fi and Late Check-Out when available. Our best price guarantee ensures that you'll always get the lowest publicly available rate. Plus, booking directly gives you more flexibility to modify reservations and provides seamless integration with your IHG One Rewards account. 

IHG One Rewards is our free, award-winning hotel loyalty programme with millions of members worldwide. When you join, your points never expire as long as your account remains active. You can redeem points for Reward Nights starting at just 10,000 points with no blackout dates. Members also enjoy exclusive Member rates that can save 10% or more, Late Check-Out when available and the opportunity to earn Elite Status as you stay more. Elite members unlock even greater perks, including complimentary room upgrades when available, bonus points and welcome amenities.

Earning points is simple and automatic. You earn points on every eligible stay at any of our thousands of hotels worldwide. You can also earn points through IHG One Rewards credit cards*, shopping and dining partners, and car hires. Redeeming points is just as easy. Use them for Reward Nights starting at 10,000 points with no blackout dates**, upgrade to premium rooms, redeem for gift cards and merchandise or combine Points + Cash to make your points go further. You can also buy, gift or transfer points through our Points Purchase programme to reach your travel goals faster. 

*IHG One Rewards credit cards are only available in selected regions. 

**Reward Night availability is limited and is subject to prior sale. 

Yes! The IHG One Rewards app is your travel companion for easier booking and better stays. Search and book from thousands of hotels worldwide, manage your reservations on the go, access exclusive mobile-only rates and use your digital room key at selected properties to skip the front desk entirely. You can also track your points, view your stays and get personalised offers tailored to your travel preferences. The app has won multiple awards and is available free on both iOS and Android devices. 

We're here to help 24/7! The easiest way to contact us is through the chat feature in the IHG One Rewards app or on IHG.com's customer care page, where you can get instant assistance with reservations, account questions and stay-related issues. You can also manage most requests directly through your IHG One Rewards account, including modifying or cancelling reservations, updating your profile and viewing your points balance. For post-stay concerns or feedback about your experience, you can also contact us through the “My Stays” section to connect with the specific property or our customer care team for resolution.

IHG Hotels & Resorts brands are yours to explore

Our diverse set of 7,000+ global destinations exist to broaden your choices with 21 hotel brands, reward your loyalty with IHG One Rewards, and invite to you to experience what True Hospitality for Good feels like with every arrival. Which brand will you choose for your next getaway?​

  1. LUXURY & LIFESTYLE COLLECTION
  2. PREMIUM COLLECTION
  3. ESSENTIALS COLLECTION
  4. SUITES COLLECTION
  5. EXCLUSIVE ALLIANCES

Elevate your meaning of extraordinary

From year-round snow skiing in Shanghai to your own private paradise in the wilds of the Indian Ocean, the Luxury & Lifestyle Collection is a celebration of unforgettable experiences. Expect unique design, gracious service and attention to every detail when you choose these distinctive hotel brands. 

Six Senses

From tropical islands to urban treasures, Six Senses creates places that live in harmony with local ecosystems and communities, helping people to reconnect to the world around them.
EXPLORE SIX SENSES

Regent Hotels

Each hotel and resort embodies a unique charm and elegance, sparking stays both serene and sensational. A place where experiences inspire stories for even the most seasoned travellers. This is Regent. 
EXPLORE REGENT

InterContinental Hotels and Resorts

Experience the exhilaration of fascinating moments and places brought to life by international know-how and local cultural wisdom.
EXPLORE INTERCONTINENTAL

Vignette Collection

A family of distinctive hotels, with a fresh focus, where you can indulge a growing passion for stays that are authentic, experiential and considerate. One that puts people at the heart of everything we do, to reframe luxury hospitality for the better. 
EXPLORE VIGNETTE

Kimpton

Truly unique properties with a guest experience to match. Enjoy thoughtful amenities, playful design and a sincerely personal style of service with the sophistication of a boutique experience.
EXPLORE KIMPTON

Hotel Indigo

We attract the curious – people who are inspired by new places – to discover unique and stylish boutique hotels in culturally diverse neighbourhoods all over the world.
Explore Hotel Indigo

Find your niche

Feel both a sense of well-being and belonging with thoughtful details and exceptional locations. Because your travel experience is both personal and purposeful, you’re invited to expand your idea of what a hotels ‘should be’ with this Premium Collection of brands.

voco

voco️ hotels offer an experience that is thoughtful, unstuffy and charming. Each property has its own sense of style and character where guests can expect a socially vibrant stay.
EXPLORE VOCO

Crowne Plaza

Crowne Plaza has long based its offering on truly understanding the blended work and life needs of its worldwide guests. Business travel isn’t just about business – it’s about balancing work and life to feel successful and fulfilled
EXPLORE CROWNE PLAZA

Ruby

At Ruby, every detail is curated with character and charm – thoughtful design, a hint of soul and a story behind every stay. A space to connect, explore and be inspired by the city around you.
EXPLORE RUBY

EVEN Hotels

Experience a premium stay with spaces designed for relaxation, dining options featuring fresh and flavourful selections, and best-in-class fitness facilities. 
EXPLORE EVEN HOTELS

HUALUXE Hotels & Resorts

At HUALUXE, we integrate unique Chinese cultural heritage into its design and service, providing an immersive experience for Chinese culture enthusiasts to dine, stay and socialise.
EXPLORE HUALUXE

Go beyond the everyday

With warm and trusted experiences like family dining and individual attention, your stays at these iconic hotels brands are defined by a legacy of true hospitality. This means the Essentials Collection is always there with just what you need – exactly when you need it.

Holiday Inn

We kept the global icon status and upgraded literally everything else. Book your next stay and see why everything has a comfort, style and atmosphere that hits different from before.
EXPLORE HOLIDAY INN

Holiday Inn Resort

From family holidays to milestone events like weddings, expect the perfect mix of relaxation and full-on fun. There's room for everyone at these beautiful destinations. 
EXPLORE HOLIDAY INN RESORT

Holiday Inn Express

Stay smarter and settle into a clean, comfortable stay with free Wi-Fi and a hot breakfast on us. Check in and expect all the essentials that help every stay feel easy.
EXPLORE HOLIDAY INN EXPRESS

Holiday Inn - the niu

Discover a dynamic, stylish and cosy escape where you can dive into the local vibe to make connections, refuel and feel inspired in the heart of vibrant city destinations.
EXPLORE HOLIDAY INN THE NIU

Garner

Garner Hotels provide a relaxed welcome, refreshing moments across the guest experience and a flexible, purposeful design that ensures the basics are delivered to support our guests, wherever they stay.
EXPLORE GARNER

avid hotels

We're purpose-built from the ground up, focusing on the essentials that make a difference.
EXPLORE AVID

Feel free to find your space

Keeping the comforts of home in reach, the Suites Collection heightens the enjoyment of your stay with choices like full kitchens, separate bedrooms, guest social hours and outdoor shared spaces that welcome connection and invite you to stay as long as you like.

Atwell Suites

Our all-suites hotels give our guests options at every turn, so they can choose a stay that’s right for them. With thoughtfully designed public spaces, an inviting bar and stylish suites, we help guests take their journey to new places.
EXPLORE ATWELL SUITES

Staybridge Suites

Creating hotels that ensure every space features a sense of community, comfort and convenience, so guests can feel at home while on the road.
EXPLORE STAYBRIDGE SUITES

Holiday Inn Club Vacations

With resorts in popular destinations featuring spacious accommodation and amenities for all ages, it's easy for families to create lasting memories together, year after year.
EXPLORE HOLIDAY INN CLUB VACATIONS

Candlewood Suites

Check in to a more casual kind of longer stay, where guests always feel at home and can settle in for multi-day stays with exactly what they need.
Explore Candlewood Suites

See paradise in a new light

Consider this exclusive assortment of beachfront holiday options that cater to your travel style – where foodies, families and friends alike find ideal resorts to gather, relax and experience some of the most beautiful beaches across four continents – all while earning and redeeming IHG One Rewards points with this valued partner. 

Iberostar Beachfront Resorts

More choice for resort and all-inclusive destinations that focus on stunning experiences and sustaining the beachfronts that surround these resorts.
EXPLORE IBEROSTAR BEACHFRONT RESORTS

Frequently Asked Questions

IHG Hotels & Resorts brands include: InterContinental Hotels & Resorts, Kimpton, Six Senses, Regent, Vignette Collection, Hotel Indigo, HUALUXE Hotels & Resorts, Crowne Plaza Hotels & Resorts, EVEN Hotels, Ruby hotels, voco hotels, Holiday Inn, Holiday Inn Express, Holiday Inn Club Vacations, Holiday Inn Resort, Garner, avid hotels, Atwell Suites, Staybridge Suites and Candlewood Suites. IHG also has an exclusive alliance with Iberostar Beachfront Resorts. 

Holiday Inn, Holiday Inn Express, Holiday Inn Club Vacations, avid hotels, Staybridge Suites and Candlewood Suites offer family-oriented amenities like suites, free meals for kids and on-site activities.

Many IHG Hotels & Resorts brands are pet-friendly, with policies varying by location. Key pet-friendly brands include: Kimpton (pets stay free), Candlewood Suites (US locations) and select locations of Hotel Indigo, Staybridge Suites and Holiday Inn. Guests should confirm pet policies directly with the hotel.

Holiday Inn Express, Garner, avid hotels, Atwell Suites and Staybridge Suites often offer free breakfast. Availability may vary depending on the specific property.

IHG Hotels & Resorts’ luxury collection includes: InterContinental Hotels & Resorts, Kimpton, Six Senses, Regent and Vignette Collection.

Staybridge Suites and Candlewood Suites are dedicated extended-stay brands.

Our dedicated suites collection consists of: Atwell Suites, Staybridge Suites, Candlewood Suites and Holiday Inn Club Vacations. However, many IHG Hotels & Resorts brands offer suites, including InterContinental Hotels & Resorts, Kimpton, Crowne Plaza Hotels & Resorts and select Holiday Inn properties.

InterContinental Hotels & Resorts, Kimpton, Crowne Plaza Hotels & Resorts, voco hotels, EVEN Hotels, Holiday Inn, Atwell Suites and Staybridge Suites provide workspaces, meeting facilities and business-friendly amenities.

Garner, avid hotels, Candlewood Suites and Holiday Inn Express focus on affordability with complimentary amenities and flexible-stay models.

Six Senses and EVEN Hotels prioritise wellness with fitness features and healthy dining options.

Kimpton, Hotel Indigo and voco hotels offer design-led, locally inspired accommodations with a boutique feel.

IHG Hotels & Resorts offers all-inclusive packages primarily through select Holiday Inn Resort and Crowne Plaza resort properties in holiday destinations like Cancun, Cozumel, Riviera Maya, Riviera Nayarit and other tropical locations. Additionally, some InterContinental resort properties may offer all-inclusive options depending on the location. IHG also has an exclusive alliance with Iberostar Beachfront Resorts. All-inclusive availability varies by specific property and destination, so it’s best to check directly with the hotel or through IHG’s website when booking to confirm which amenities and services are included in the package.
